title: Standard Window 1 page alignment across M17 apps
scope: Verified the Standard Window 1 page-shell and scrollbar discipline across the seven published M17 apps. Calendar and Patient Record were the only pages with an additional outer inset; the other five already used the shared viewport geometry.

design.discipline: The app page fills the window content area and uses the shared inset once. Overflow uses the six-pixel scrollbar positioned four pixels from the page edge, without an extra framed scroll-content card or workspace gutter.
preserved: Follow-ups and Appointments summary cards remain in their established position.
Each app keeps its app-specific controls, tables, calendar grid, detail pages, workflows and pagination behavior.

changes.change: Removed the extra framed scroll-content wrapper and now use the shared page inset directly.
Removed the legacy care-workspace padding on the directory page while keeping detail and intake layouts scoped to their existing workspace behavior.

privateUi.commonGeometryAssertions: Each fixture verifies the shared page viewport, a scroll shell filling the app page, and the six-pixel scrollbar positioned four pixels from the page edge. App-specific workflow assertions also remain enabled.

verification.publicStagingVerification: passed: signed catalogue and policy, seven current identities, retained release grants, package bytes/signatures, and isolated registry install/launch/uninstall for all seven apps
verification.documentationCheck: passed: python3 tools/check-dental-docs.py; 24 architecture docs, 18 milestones, 72 required milestone records, 16 requirements, 18 acceptance gates, 14 invariants; no errors

limits: The published updates are signed Cloudflare staging releases; no authenticated Store install or live clinic business write was performed in this follow-up.
The existing six-grant OS session remained running and was not restarted. App Store Refresh reads the updated staging catalogue.
No production publication, push or merge occurred.
